metadata.title: get-ICAfile_v3
metadata.description: A Powershell v3 Script that utilizes invoke-webrequest to create, download and launch an application via Citrix ICA file from Storefront.  Script requires an unauthenticated store and unauthenticated published application.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.
